newsitem.title: INDIA: Cochin Refineries shuts production plants.
newsitem.headline: Cochin Refineries shuts production plants.

text.p: India's state-controlled Cochin Refineries Ltd closed all production plants on Monday due to an acute water shortage, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The production loss to the firm will amount to about 30 million rupees ($838,000) per day, the news agency quoted a company spokesman as saying
The spokesman said the firm had at least a week's supply of petroleum products, including liquefied petroleum gas, in stock.
He said the local water authority in the southern state of Kerala had failed to meet the refineries' daily water demand.

The water authority had agreed to supply 22,750 kilolitres of water daily to the refineries but was actually providing just 8,450 kilolitres, which made it virtually impossible to run the plants, PTI quoted the spokesman as saying. ($1=35.8 rupees)
